system.description: A Maginos is built of a material, and each is a race of its own: Maginos(Clay), Maginos(Metal), Maginos(Stone), Maginos(Wood). This entry is the [Other] material his sheet offers for one made of something unlisted; its figures are his Clay ones.

The Fortune modifier below is left at 0 until that roll is made. This is the winged form. In his sheet wings belong to the slight-physique branch of this race, so a character of this race is always of slight physique (-1 Strength, +1 Agility) and the generator does not offer the choice.

A Formless has no body of its own. It must inhabit a HOST race, which supplies its Strength, Agility, Vitality, Appearance and Social Class, its starting Endurance, its Perception, all of its movement and whether it can swim; this race supplies everything else. Hold both this race and the host race on the character. Without a host the physical half of the character is blank, which his sheet refuses outright. 110 races may be inhabited. A Changeling, a Mechanos and a Giant(Civilized:Seafaring) may not, and neither may another Formless, a Famorian or a Maginos. A Formless can never be half of a Half Race, and does not take on a host's magical abilities, so it cannot use a host's transformations.
abilities: Superior Regeneration(Heals 1d6 points of non-fire/acid damage per 10 seconds to all body areas. Dies if head is destroyed or seperated from the heart.)

Corporeal Posession(Can posses physical forms lacking spirit and soul. Must make a Control Resistance to do so. Fail = no further attempts. For the first 30 minutes(-1 minute per WIL) control of the new form is at -1/-5% to all physical actions. Duration of possession varies. Mindless Husks: 1 Week per WIL. Control Resistance once per week at -5% cumulative or be rejected. Humanoid Corpse: -5% Control Resist for each hour it has already been dead. Once possessed. Lasts 1 Day per WIL. Control Resistance once per day at -5% cumulative or be rejected. Animal Corpse: -5% Control Resist for each 10 minutes it has already been dead. Once possessed. Lasts 10 minutes per WIL. Control Resistance once per 10 minutes at -5% cumulative or be rejected.)
disabilities: Detached Psyche(Being's soul, holds the spirit, which holds the mind without a body. Dependent on the possession of other physical forms. Survives unharmed outside a body for 1 hour per WIL. Thereafter must make a Control Resistance. Every failure is -1 WIL. Every failure requires a WIL Save to avoid insanity. Without a form, WIL losses continue without recovery until death at 0 WIL.)

system.description: A Famorian is beast-blooded, and its body is built rather than fixed. A d100 gives its BREED, the breed says how many EVOKES it may take, and each evoke is a beast trait. The figures below are a Famorian that has taken none of them. 120 evokes are offered. Strength, Agility and Vitality each add 1d3 when taken; twelve more change Endurance, a resistance, the special movement, the speed multiplier or the jump; the rest are abilities with no figure attached and are listed rather than applied, as racial abilities already are. An animal type must be chosen before the race can be applied, as his sheet requires. 1-10 Hidden Breed: 1 evoke(s). Only occurs during stress 11-20 Trace Breed: 1d2 evoke(s). Always On. Single animal package. 21-40 Low Breed: 1d4 evoke(s). Always On. Single animal package. 41-60 Breed: 1d4+1 evoke(s). Always On. Single animal package. 61-90 High Breed: 1d6+1 evoke(s). Always On. Single animal package. 91-95 True Breed: All evoke(s). Always On. Single animal package. 96-100 Inbreed: 1d6+2 evoke(s). Always On. One or more animal packages.
